description: This file defines an HRRepository class responsible for managing employee data, including CRUD operations, with sample in-memory data initialization. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and filtering employee records.

classes.name: HRRepository
classes.description: Repository for managing employee records in memory, providing methods for CRUD operations and filtering.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the repository and loads sample employee data.

methods.name: _initialize_sample_data(self)
methods.description: Populates the repository with predefined sample employee records.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create(self, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new employee record with a unique ID, timestamps, and provided data.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_by_id(self, item_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an employee record by its ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_all(self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Fetches all employee records with support for pagination and filters such as department, status, and search.

methods.name: int count(self, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Counts the number of employee records matching optional filters.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update(self, item_id: int, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing employee record identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: bool delete(self, item_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes an employee record by ID.
